en: A black‑and‑white old photograph of a wide, muddy residential street lined with substantial late‑19th‑century townhouses and villas. People in formal Edwardian‑era clothing—men in suits and bowler or top hats, women in long dark dresses and hats, and several children—stand and walk along the street and sidewalks. High masonry walls with iron fences enclose gardens on both sides. The architecture features stucco facades, mansard or steep tiled roofs, and decorative window surrounds typical of Central European bourgeois districts.
